description: Canonical machine-readable metadata registry of the 43 ARS prompt roles for selective role routing and token optimization.

deep-research/research_question_agent.short_description: Transforms vague topics into precise, FINER-evaluated researchable questions through iterative refinement
deep-research/research_question_agent.trigger_conditions: Topic definition, research question refinement, FINER scoping

deep-research/research_architect_agent.short_description: Designs the methodological blueprint; selects research paradigm, method, data strategy, and analytical framework
deep-research/research_architect_agent.trigger_conditions: Methodology blueprint, research paradigm selection, data strategy

deep-research/bibliography_agent.short_description: Systematic literature search and curation; identifies, annotates, and formats sources in APA 7.0
deep-research/bibliography_agent.trigger_conditions: Database queries, source retrieval, search strings, bibliography curation

deep-research/source_verification_agent.short_description: Grades evidence, detects predatory publications, and fact-checks claims entering the research pipeline
deep-research/source_verification_agent.trigger_conditions: Evidence grading (I-VII), predatory journal screening, COI detection

deep-research/synthesis_agent.short_description: Integrates findings across sources, resolves evidence conflicts, and maps knowledge gaps
deep-research/synthesis_agent.trigger_conditions: Thematic cross-source synthesis, gap analysis, theoretical framing

deep-research/report_compiler_agent.short_description: Transforms research findings into polished APA 7.0 academic reports; activated in Phase 4 and Phase 6

deep-research/editor_in_chief_agent.short_description: Q1 journal editorial review; delivers Accept/Reject verdict with actionable feedback on research reports
deep-research/editor_in_chief_agent.trigger_conditions: Final report review, quality scoring, editorial verdict

deep-research/devils_advocate_agent.short_description: Challenges assumptions, tests logical chains, and stress-tests research arguments at mandatory checkpoints
deep-research/devils_advocate_agent.trigger_conditions: Checkpoint critique, counter-argument stress tests, cherry-picking checks

deep-research/ethics_review_agent.short_description: Research ethics self-check (before a human committee/IRB, not a replacement); confirms Critical integrity concerns before delivery — stops the user once, overridable, never a veto
deep-research/ethics_review_agent.trigger_conditions: Ethics screening, human subjects administrative status, dual-use checks

deep-research/socratic_mentor_agent.short_description: Guides researchers through Socratic questioning to clarify and sharpen their research thinking
deep-research/socratic_mentor_agent.trigger_conditions: Guided research exploration, cognitive scaffolding, question taxonomy

deep-research/risk_of_bias_agent.short_description: Assesses risk of bias in included studies using RoB 2 (RCTs) and ROBINS-I (non-randomized studies)
deep-research/risk_of_bias_agent.trigger_conditions: RoB 2 / ROBINS-I study-level risk assessment in evidence synthesis

deep-research/meta_analysis_agent.short_description: Quantitative synthesis of included studies; computes effect sizes, assesses heterogeneity, and applies GRADE framework
deep-research/meta_analysis_agent.trigger_conditions: Quantitative effect size pooling, heterogeneity (I^2), funnel plot asymmetry

deep-research/monitoring_agent.short_description: Post-research literature monitoring; helps users track new publications and developments after a research project is complete
deep-research/monitoring_agent.trigger_conditions: Literature update tracking, post-publication alerts, RSS monitoring strategy

deep-research/timeline_extraction_agent.short_description: Extracts per-source temporal facts and citation provenance into Phase 2 sidecar artifacts; activated in Phase 2 (Investigation)
deep-research/timeline_extraction_agent.trigger_conditions: Chronological evolution of scientific concepts, discovery timeline mapping

academic-paper/intake_agent.short_description: Conducts the paper configuration interview and produces the Paper Configuration Record for downstream agents
academic-paper/intake_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 0 configuration interview, target journal/citation selection

academic-paper/literature_strategist_age.short_description: Designs the literature search strategy and manages source selection for the paper
academic-paper/literature_strategist_age.trigger_conditions: Phase 1 literature search and bibliography construction for paper writing

academic-paper/structure_architect_agent.short_description: Designs the papers section architecture and detailed outline before drafting begins
academic-paper/structure_architect_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 2 structure selection, detailed section outline, word count budget

academic-paper/argument_builder_agent.short_description: Constructs the papers core argument and logical reasoning structure
academic-paper/argument_builder_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 3 Claim-Evidence-Reasoning (CER) chains, thesis defense blueprint

academic-paper/draft_writer_agent.short_description: Writes the full paper draft section by section from the structured outline and Paper Configuration Record
academic-paper/draft_writer_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 4 section-by-section writing and revision drafting

academic-paper/citation_compliance_agent.short_description: Verifies citations against the target journals format requirements and flags non-compliant entries
academic-paper/citation_compliance_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 5a in-text citation <-> reference list zero-orphan audit

academic-paper/abstract_bilingual_agent.short_description: Writes and translates abstracts in English and the target language to journal format standards
academic-paper/abstract_bilingual_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 5b paired bilingual abstract (default zh-TW + EN) generation

academic-paper/peer_reviewer_agent.short_description: Simulates peer review to identify weaknesses and suggest improvements before submission
academic-paper/peer_reviewer_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 6 simulated internal double-blind peer review report

academic-paper/formatter_agent.short_description: Formats the final manuscript output to target journal style requirements
academic-paper/formatter_agent.trigger_conditions: Phase 7 document formatting (LaTeX, DOCX, PDF) and journal styling

academic-paper/socratic_mentor_agent.short_description: Guides paper authors through Socratic questions to sharpen arguments and surface unstated assumptions
academic-paper/socratic_mentor_agent.trigger_conditions: Plan mode chapter-by-chapter Socratic dialogue and INSIGHT harvesting

academic-paper/visualization_agent.short_description: Generates publication-quality figure specifications and chart descriptions for inclusion in the paper
academic-paper/visualization_agent.trigger_conditions: Scientific figure and chart script generation (Python/R) with APA styling

academic-paper/revision_coach_agent.short_description: Parses reviewer or real-committee comments into source-accounted plans and response skeletons
academic-paper/revision_coach_agent.trigger_conditions: Parsing unstructured reviews into Revision Roadmap and Response Skeleton

academic-paper-reviewer/field_analyst_ag.short_description: Identifies the papers field and dynamically configures the reviewer teams identities and expertise
academic-paper-reviewer/field_analyst_ag.trigger_conditions: Phase 0 paper analysis, domain detection, generating Reviewer Cards

academic-paper-reviewer/eic_agent.short_description: Journal-Fit Reviewer seat; contributes the journal-fit / originality / overall-quality review card — the final editorial decision is editorial_synthesizer_agent's Phase 2 work
academic-paper-reviewer/eic_agent.trigger_conditions: Journal-Fit Reviewer: scope, readership, priority, editorial framing

academic-paper-reviewer/methodology_revi.short_description: Peer Reviewer 1; assesses methodological soundness, research design validity, and statistical rigor
academic-paper-reviewer/methodology_revi.trigger_conditions: Peer Reviewer 1: research design rigor, statistics, reproducibility

academic-paper-reviewer/domain_reviewer_.short_description: Peer Reviewer 2; assesses domain expertise, substantive accuracy, and field-specific adequacy
academic-paper-reviewer/domain_reviewer_.trigger_conditions: Peer Reviewer 2: domain literature coverage, theoretical contribution

academic-paper-reviewer/perspective_revi.short_description: Peer Reviewer 3; evaluates cross-disciplinary relevance, broader impact, and alternative interpretations
academic-paper-reviewer/perspective_revi.trigger_conditions: Peer Reviewer 3: cross-disciplinary potential, policy/social impact

academic-paper-reviewer/devils_advocate_.short_description: Challenges core arguments and logical coherence as the devils advocate reviewer in the editorial panel
academic-paper-reviewer/devils_advocate_.trigger_conditions: Review seat 5: hardest counter-arguments, cherry-picking, bias audit

academic-paper-reviewer/editorial_synthe.short_description: Synthesizes all reviewer reports into a unified editorial decision letter and revision roadmap
academic-paper-reviewer/editorial_synthe.trigger_conditions: Phase 2 synthesis: Editorial Decision Letter and immutable Revision Roadmap

academic-pipeline/pipeline_orchestrator_.short_description: Orchestrates the full multi-skill academic research pipeline and manages agent handoffs across phases
academic-pipeline/pipeline_orchestrator_.trigger_conditions: Full multi-stage pipeline orchestration, transitions, and checkpoints

academic-pipeline/state_tracker_agent.short_description: Tracks pipeline state and maintains the research session history across multi-phase workflows
academic-pipeline/state_tracker_agent.trigger_conditions: Tracking stage deliverables, passport updates, revision loop count

academic-pipeline/integrity_verification.short_description: Runs coverage-bounded checks on registered references, citation contexts, data surfaces, and claims before review and after revision
academic-pipeline/integrity_verification.trigger_conditions: Stage 2.5 and 4.5 integrity verification gates (claims, data, citations)

academic-pipeline/collaboration_depth_ag.short_description: Post-hoc observer scoring user-AI collaboration depth against the canonical rubric; advisory-only, never blocks pipeline progression
academic-pipeline/collaboration_depth_ag.trigger_conditions: Advisory collaboration scoring at FULL/SLIM checkpoints and Stage 6

academic-pipeline/claim_ref_alignment_au.short_description: L3 claim-faithfulness audit — judges every cited claim against the retrieved reference text, surfaces uncited assertions and constraint violations, and feeds the Stage 4→5 formatter hard gate

sr-screener/protocol_architect_agent.short_description: Turns a proposal or protocol into confirmed, stage-split screening rules and a screening config before any record is screened
sr-screener/protocol_architect_agent.trigger_conditions: Screening protocol design, eligibility criteria, exclusion codes

sr-screener/screening_reviewer_agent.short_description: Blinded screening reviewer for sr-screener: applies a confirmed protocol to one batch of records or one full-text report and returns one decision per record
sr-screener/screening_reviewer_agent.trigger_conditions: Independent blinded record screening, conflict adjudication, and QC

sr-screener/qc_auditor_agent.short_description: Reports seeds, agreement, conflicts and recheck results after the pilot and the full run, and proposes protocol clarifications
sr-screener/qc_auditor_agent.trigger_conditions: Senior quality control audit of excluded and borderline records

sr-screener/reporter_agent.short_description: Builds the screening deliverables (log, RIS groups, PRISMA counts, methods draft, corpus handoff) from complete decisions
sr-screener/reporter_agent.trigger_conditions: Compiling PRISMA flow numbers, screening log, and methods paragraph

shared/compliance_agent.short_description: Runs PRISMA-trAIce + RAISE compliance checks at Stage 2.5 / 4.5 integrity gates and emits Schema 12 compliance_report
shared/compliance_agent.trigger_conditions: RAISE compliance principles check before paper finalization
